description: This file implements a command-line interface for managing NVRAM (Non-Volatile RAM) settings, including commands like show, get, set, unset, info, and commit, using functions from the libnvram library.

methods.name: nvram_open_rdonly
methods.description: Opens the NVRAM in read-only mode, trying staging first, then MTD if staging is unavailable.

methods.name: nvram_open_staging
methods.description: Opens the staging area of NVRAM for read-write access.

methods.name: do_show
methods.description: Displays all key-value pairs stored in the NVRAM.

methods.name: do_get
methods.description: Retrieves and prints the value of a specified variable from NVRAM.

methods.name: do_unset
methods.description: Removes a specified variable from NVRAM.

methods.name: do_set
methods.description: Sets a variable in NVRAM with a specified value.

methods.name: do_info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about the NVRAM header and usage.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the command-line tool.
